This file is an adapter surface for GitHub Copilot-style agents and coding assistance.

Before proposing or applying changes, use the Law Firm authority chain:
- `AI_START_HERE.md`
- `AGENTS.md`
- `registry/source-of-truth.json`
- `registry/design-authority.json`
